column1: # notes: The 2 nm oxide MOS capacitor on 1e17 p silicon with density gradient electrons
column2: Wettstein's log form with the Garcia-Loureiro oxide boundary term
column3: the same equations as devsim/devsim_density_gradient but written out here with ddsim's constants. ddsim writes the mesh nodes
column4: the doping and the gate and body boundary potentials to data/golden/dg_moscap_2nm_inputs.json
column5: and the generator builds the identical 1D mesh from them
column6: so the two codes solve one discretization and the tolerance is 1e-6 rather than the 3 percent PHASE-17 asks; a 20 percent error in one coefficient of the gradient term moves the charge by only 1.2 percent. gamma 8.72 is the value that matches ddsim's Schrodinger-Poisson inversion charge at 1.5 V.
